reviewDispositions.rationale: The clinical scene and safety-critical item now define 17.2 mg/dL as cross-sectional one-time prediction error, state that the dataset has no within-person variance estimate, and remove both the detectability conclusion and the claim that the patient's residual identifies or would preserve a causal gap.

The reverse fit remains only to show that ordinary least squares answers direction-specific conditional-mean questions. The text explicitly rejects reciprocal slopes as a causal test and bases the non-causal conclusion on the observational between-person design, confounding, and absence of intervention or longitudinal contrast.

The diagnostic cut-point comparison was removed from the clinical scene and assessment. The final text states that the dataset supplies no management target or clinically important difference, and the now-unused health-sensitive claim, NIDDK reference, and attribution entry were removed.

The weak-fit section now says that a sufficiently precise interval could bound only the population linear association under the fitted model and measured-variable definitions. It explicitly states that this observational fit is not evidence against a large causal effect.

The glossary and both matching scenes now define leverage from predictor-space extremeness, distinguish it from a large residual, and describe influence as the consequential combination of leverage and residual size. The related claim and source-note mappings were extended to those scenes.

Categorical claims that the straight form is right or the shape is fine were replaced with the bounded conclusion that the residual plot provides no clear evidence against a straight-line form over the observed range and does not prove that form true or uniquely correct.

The adjusted-coefficient teaching answer and assessment reasoning now state only that adding the covariates materially changed the fitted conditional association. They explicitly withhold causal decomposition without causal structure, measurement quality, comparable covariate combinations, and correct specification.

The reviewer independently reproduced the sixty-pair fit, residual summaries, constructed examples, and keyed arithmetic and requested no numerical correction. The finalization preserved the chart data and all reviewed fitted quantities.
